proposition: Four later papers (Prologue fn 34, Sensorium, New Brethren, Timurid-Mughal) call Iskandar Sulṭān Ibn Turka's first Timurid patron, and none of the pages read mentions Pīr-Muḥammad's court. The dissertation places Ibn Turka at Pīr-Muḥammad's court in Shiraz c. 810-12/1408-9 before Iskandar, and says Iskandar honoured him presumably with a teaching post and judgeship.

mediation.note: 'first' may mean first Timurid patron of lettrist works; the papers do not say
